memos.argument: A classifier separates pulverized coal (a solid mineral fuel in powder form) by particle size; 8474 covers machinery for sorting, screening, separating, crushing, grinding of mineral substances in solid/powder form, and 8474.10 'sorting, screening, separating or washing machines' fits; parts go to 8474.90 if sold as mill parts.
exclusions_against: Ch.84 Note 2: a machine answering both 8401-8424 and 8425-8480 goes to the earlier group, so if it also fits 8416 or 8421 that would prevail over 8474
No CROSS ruling retrieved for classifiers; multiple searches returned only irrelevant HQ rulings
If merely a part of a pulverizer/boiler, parts rules (Sec XVI Notes) could shift it

memos.argument: Heading covers centrifuges and filtering or purifying machinery for liquids or gases; a dynamic classifier with rotating classifier wheel in a pressurized housing separating particles from an air/coal stream might be argued as separating solids from gas.
exclusions_against: 8421 covers filtering/purifying of gases, but the purpose here is sizing a product, not purifying
Particle-size sorting of mineral solids is the more specific text of 8474.10
No supporting ruling found in searches

memos.argument: 8416 covers furnace burners for pulverized solid fuel and parts thereof; the classifier is integral to the coal pulverizer feeding burners in power-plant boilers, so it could be argued as a part of pulverized-fuel burner equipment.
exclusions_against: Classifier is a mill component upstream of the burner, not a burner part; 8416.90 covers parts of burners/stokers
Mills (grinding) fall in 8474.20, with parts in 8474.90, which is more specific
No supporting ruling found; 8416 is not obviously a heading for pulverizers
